name: tia_export_project_files
description: Export the project to a folder for version control: per PLC all blocks (SimaticML .xml, plus .scl source for SCL blocks), UDTs, PLC tag tables, watch and force tables, and the hardware as AML. Layout: plc/<PLC>/{blocks,types,tags,watch,force}/<group path>/<name>.xml, hardware/project.aml, tia-export.json (sorted file list, no timestamps). Unchanged files are left untouched and files of deleted objects are removed (remove_stale), so Git diffs stay small. Inconsistent or know-how protected blocks are reported as errors.

output_directory.description: Folder to export into (created if missing), e.g. the 'tia-export' folder of the project repository.

plc_name.description: Optional PLC software name; omit for all PLCs.

include_scl.description: Also write .scl sources for SCL blocks (default: true).

remove_stale.description: Delete files listed in the previous tia-export.json that were not exported now (default: true).
